content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a self-owned system for selling digital products. Unlike platforms that rent you access, this architecture is yours to control. It combines free and low-cost tools into a stack that handles hosting, order processing, file delivery, and payment verification. The core payment layer uses Bitcoin and cryptocurrencies via NOWPayments, a service that verifies on-chain transactions without requiring buyer accounts or KYC. This eliminates dependency on Stripe, PayPal, or local banks. The system is designed to withstand payment rejections, currency volatility, and financial isolation—problems creators in Kenya and similar regions face daily. It’s not a workaround; it’s base-layer infrastructure built to last.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack operates in layers. First, your product files are hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which process orders and trigger file delivery. Order data is stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, depending on your stack choice. When a buyer pays, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and sends a webhook to your backend. The script then delivers the product file via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Cryptocurrency payments are priced in USD and converted at transaction time, ensuring you receive the correct value. The entire process is automated, secure, and runs without ongoing fees or subscriptions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or unreliable. If you’re in Kenya, Nigeria, Zimbabwe, or similar markets, this system gives you the tools to sell globally without intermediaries. It’s also for creators who value ownership over their infrastructure. Once deployed, the stack is yours—no platform can shut you down, change fees, or alter terms. You’re not renting access; you’re building equity in your own commerce system. This is infrastructure sovereignty, designed for creators who choose better architecture over workarounds.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full ownership of your sales system—no platforms, no subscriptions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack relies on five key components. First, hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve your storefront and product pages. Second, backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle order processing and file delivery. Third, order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets log transactions and customer data. Fourth, file delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 store and serve product files. Fifth, payment processing: NOWPayments verifies Bitcoin and cryptocurrency payments on-chain, charging a flat 0.5% fee. These components integrate seamlessly, creating a system that’s both lightweight and robust. Each tool is chosen for its reliability, cost-efficiency, and ease of deployment.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing a stack based on your needs. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is ideal for beginners, deploying GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments in 48 hours. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers advanced features like Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. For full control, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates for instant deployment. Each option comes with 30-day support and lifetime access. Once deployed, load your products, set your prices in USD, and begin selling. The system handles the rest—from payment verification to file delivery. You own the infrastructure, and it works for you, not the other way around.

It eliminates dependency on platforms like Stripe or PayPal by using Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies via services like NOWPayments. This architecture is designed for creators in regions with restricted payment options, providing full control and reliability without ongoing fees or subscriptions.
Bitcoin and cryptocurrency payments eliminate reliance on banks or payment processors, even in restricted regions.

It’s the fastest way to gain full ownership of your digital sales system, with lifetime access and no recurring costs. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack, Edge Commerce Stack, or Complete Builder Kit. 2. Purchase and receive deployment instructions within 48 hours. 3. Load your products into the system and set USD prices. 4. Configure NOWPayments for Bitcoin or cryptocurrency payments. 5. Test the entire flow—from payment to file delivery—before going live. 6. Launch your storefront and begin selling globally. 7. Monitor transactions and customer data via Supabase or Google Sheets.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this system if I’m not technical?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack include deployment within 48 hours, requiring no technical expertise. The Complete Builder Kit provides full documentation for those who want to customize their stack.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need to pay recurring fees?
No. The infrastructure is self-owned, with no subscriptions. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% charge per transaction. Hosting, backend, and storage tools are either free or low-cost.
What happens if a payment fails?
NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain. If a transaction fails, the buyer is prompted to try again. Once payment confirms, the system automatically delivers the product file.
Can I scale this system as my business grows?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack and Complete Builder Kit include scaling playbooks. You can add more products, upgrade storage, or optimize backend logic as needed.
